svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Axis 1: wiring shape (choose exactly one per Assembly) · Axis 2: capability flags (independent of shape)
one physical unit — sensing, logic and
straight 1:1 chain, each stage wired to
its neighbor only — no shared stage
its own I/O (shown once, for clarity)
capability flags apply independently to any shape above
any Control Unit, in any shape above, deployed as a redundant pair
on failure, Standby takes over the shared inputs/outputs —
the shape above (Point-to-Point, Star or Mesh) is unchanged
any Control Unit, in any shape above, streams telemetry upward
telemetry feeds the AI layer regardless of shape — Integrated,
Point-to-Point, Star and Mesh all expose the same interface
the physical process / equipment every shape above ultimately drives (Purdue L0, Sub-model 2)
